source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), LastLoadTime, 126) AS OldWatermark FROM dbo.PipelineWatermark WHERE TableName = 'Customers_Incremental'
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), MAX(LastModifiedDate), 126) AS NewWatermark FROM dbo.Customers_Incremental

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT CustomerID, CustomerName, City, LastModifiedDate FROM dbo.Customers_Incremental WHERE LastModifiedDate > ''', activity('Lookup_Old_Watermark').output.firstRow.OldWatermark, ''' AND LastModifiedDate <= ''', activity('Lookup_New_Watermark').output.firstRow.NewWatermark, '''')
